original_target: Historical noncooperating Windows Virtual Memory system dialog;current PID/HWND/executable/Host/Boot/Session/Desktop identities UNKNOWN and not collected.

criteria.readiness_before_observation: Hook/session registration and a ready message loop can be evidenced prospectively;not a retrospective source-side barrier for an already-existing target.
criteria.preexisting_window_provenance: Current enumeration/process rundown is not the required prior window creation anchor.
criteria.trusted_hwnd_generation: No assessed public observer field supplies independently trusted creation-generation lineage for the original target.
criteria.emission_and_recording_completeness: Standard WinEvents exist,but no reviewed original-target provider+coverage attestation is available.
criteria.loss_reentrancy_order_detection: Some loss/order failures are detectable;queue-order guarantees,completion reentrancy,session loss and source omission are different layers.
criteria.independent_full_coverage_certificate: Not supplied or independently obtainable with the assessed public observer evidence alone.

options.name: Cooperating instrumented window owner

criteria.readiness_before_observation: Before any owner creation,register independent witnesses and commit a ready barrier.
criteria.preexisting_window_provenance: Requires an independently preserved owner creation journal from before birth;otherwise UNKNOWN.
criteria.trusted_hwnd_generation: Owner must mint a unique generation at creation,not derive it from HWND or a sampled title.
criteria.emission_and_recording_completeness: Review every creation/destruction/library/child path within exact domain;crash and partial outcome remain unknown.
criteria.loss_reentrancy_order_detection: Independent owner/source sequence,epoch and outside heads;loss/restart/contradiction halt.
criteria.independent_full_coverage_certificate: Conditional only after source/attestation/clock/durability/independent interval proof are qualified for that cooperating owner.

options.scope_boundary: A separate owner/test target does not qualify the original system dialog. No test window was created in this task.

options.name: Independently attested OS/kernel witness

criteria.readiness_before_observation: Would require an attested OS source barrier established before the covered interval.
criteria.preexisting_window_provenance: Would require trustworthy persisted creation/generation history or a separately justified bootstrap certificate.
criteria.trusted_hwnd_generation: Requires a documented OS-backed generation with nonreuse and process/window binding semantics.
criteria.emission_and_recording_completeness: Requires vendor/security-reviewed source-coverage guarantees;generic ETW/driver signing is insufficient.
criteria.loss_reentrancy_order_detection: Requires attested event origin,epoch,loss observability and reliable causal sequencing.
criteria.independent_full_coverage_certificate: No concrete qualified implementation,provider,trust source or deployment authorization is currently available.

options.scope_boundary: Documents and architecture only;no driver,hook,injection,OS modification or privileged runtime.
